projects.name: Captive 1.0MW Solar Hybrid Power Plant at Alex Ekwueme University Ndufu-Alike Ikwo
projects.completion: The Project was successfully commissioned on 2nd August 2019 with +9,500 staff and students now receiving adequate and reliable power. The project is in the process of being handed over to the university management, having completed over 1 year of O&M services and successfully trained the university staff to operate and maintain the power plant, WTC and streetlights.

projects.name: Captive 0.5MW Solar Hybrid Power Plant at University of Petroleum Resources Effurun
projects.completion: All components of the project have been completed, including the pre commissioning tests on the distribution network. It is ready to be officially commissioned and to commence the O&M phase of the project.

projects.name: Captive 0.5MW Solar Hybrid Power Plant at Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University, Bauchi
projects.completion: The Project was technically commissioned on 2nd February 2020 and the university has been receiving adequate and reliable power since then. The project is set for official commissioning and handover having completed the O&M phase and trained the university staff, in January 2021

projects.name: Captive 3.0MW Solar Hybrid Power Plant at Bayero University, Kano State
projects.completion: The Project was successfully commissioned on 3rd September 2019 with +58,000 staff and students receiving adequate and reliable power. After completion of over 1 year of operations and maintenance of the power plant and training of the university staff to operate and maintain same, provided by the EPC/O&M Contractor, the EEP project was handed over to the university management on the 3rd December 2020 with all relevant project documentation .
